entries.german:
Abt Rudolf von St. Gallen verleiht der Propstei St. Peterzell gegen einen jährlichen Zins das Gut Ahorn.

+ In nomine sancte et individue trinitatis amen + . Ego Rv odolfus abbas sancti Galli 1. Cum facta || mortalium caduca sint et transitoria, discreta prudentum virorum industria rerum gestarum noticiam, ne processu || temporis evanescat, literarum indiciis censuit eternari. Notum sit igitur tam presentibus quam futuris omnibus bone || voluntatis hominibus, quod Egelolfus de Rôrschach 2 cruce signatus 3 predium in Ahorn 4 situm, quod ex hereditaria sibi divisione contigerat, celle sancti Petri in Nekertal 5 obtinendum patruelibus suis Rv odolfo et Egelolfo de Rôrshach 6 et nepotibus suis Wernhero et Diethalmo de Tunretvn 7 commisit tempore gloriosissimi Romanorum imperatoris Heinrici, advocatiam vero eiusdem predii Egelolfo patrueli suo de Rosinberc 8 sub annuali censu unius solidi contradidit. Decurso postmodum longo iam tempore Rv odolfus de Rôrscach et sui filii residuam partem prefati predii, que post mortem Egilolfi de Rosinberc hereditaria eis successione adheserat, memorate sancti Petri celle quadraginta marcarum precio vendiderunt, statuentes, ut ex ipsis vel eorum successoribus a se descendentibus uno solo advocatiam tenente duo tantum solidi de dato simul et empto predio iure advocaticio annuatim persolvantur et cella sepedicta ad maiora nunquam compellatur servitia. Commissionem autem proprietatis super donatione primaria, quam Rv odolfus de Rorschah et Wernherus et Diethalmus de Tvnretvn ad conservationis cautelam ab Egelolfo cruce signato susceperant, necnon et ea proprietatis iura, que Rvdolfus de Rôrscah et sui filii super venditione ab eis facta possederant, ecclesie beati Galli libere et absolute contradiderunt. Nos igitur communicato totius capituli nostri ac ministerialium et hominum nostre familie consilio predium memoratum celle sancti Petri in Nekartal sub annuali censu unius solidi in festo Thome persolvendi iure feodali concessimus obtinendum. Ne autem tam rotionabilis a) infeodatio ullo malignorum incursu valeat attemptari vel etiam oblivionis caligine a futurorum noticia repelli, presentem paginam inde fecimus conscribi et nostri ac capituli nostri sigilli testimonio communiri. Actum publice apud sanctum Gallum, anno dominice incarnationis M.CC.XXII. indictione X. anno decemnovenalis cycli VII. epactis VI. concurrentibus V. litera dominicali B. kl. maii, presentibus nobis anno electionis nostre III°. presidente papa Honorio III. pontificatus sui anno VI. regnante gloriosissimo Romanorum imperatore Friderico anno imperii eius III. Testes, qui interfuerunt, sunt hii: Manegoldus decanus 9, Chonradus prepositus 10, Livtoldus decanus 11, Burchardus custos 12, Gozoldus, Hermannus, Chonradus, Rvdolfus, Rv odegerus, magister Chonradus, Heinricus, Gotefridus, Burchardus, Ernesto, Egelolfus de Capella 13, Waltherus plebanus de Kilchberc 14, Vlricus plebanus de Gozowe 15, Heinricus plebanus in Watewillâr 16, Vlricus dapifer 17, Heinricus marscalcus de Ualkenstein 18, Wernherus et Diethalmus fratres de Tunretvn, Vlricus de Nidirndorf 19, Chonradus de Curia, Heinricus de Bichewillâr 20, Chonradus camerarius 21, Livtoldus de Swarcinbach 22, Willehelmus de Steinahe 23, Heinricus de Steige 24, Bertoldus cocus 25, Rv odolfus dispensator 26, magister Gerungus et alii quamplures, in domino feliciter amen.

Siegel: 2 Siegel an farbigen Schnüren, stark besch., 1. Abb. 7; 2. Abb. 2.
entries.english:
Abbot Rudolf of St. Gallen grants the estate of Ahorn to the provostry of St. Peterzell in fief, for an annual rent.

In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity. I, Rudolf, abbot of St. Gall. Since human deeds are fleeting and transitory, the prudent diligence of wise men has judged that knowledge of what has been done should be made lasting through written records, lest it fade with time. Therefore let it be known to all people of good will, present and future, that Egelolf of Rorschach, having taken the cross, entrusted the estate at Ahorn, which had fallen to him by hereditary division, to his cousins Rudolf and Egelolf of Rorschach and his nephews Wernher and Diethalm of Thundorf, to be held by the cell of St. Peter in the Neckar valley, in the time of the most glorious Roman Emperor Heinrich. He granted the bailiwick of that estate to his cousin Egelolf of Rosenberg for an annual rent of one solidus. After a long time, Rudolf of Rorschach and his sons sold to the aforesaid cell of St. Peter, for forty marks, the remaining part of the estate which had passed to them by hereditary succession after the death of Egelolf of Rosenberg. They stipulated that, from them or their descendants, with only one person holding the bailiwick, only two solidi in all should be paid annually in bailiwick rent on the estate, whether donated or purchased, and that the said cell should never be compelled to greater services. Rudolf of Rorschach, Wernher, and Diethalm of Thundorf had received from Egelolf, who had taken the cross, the title to the original donation as security; they freely and absolutely transferred that title, as well as the rights Rudolf of Rorschach and his sons held through their sale, to the church of St. Gall. We therefore, with the counsel of our whole chapter, ministeriales, and household dependents, have granted the aforesaid estate to the cell of St. Peter in the Neckar valley to hold in fief, for an annual rent of one solidus payable on the feast of St. Thomas. To prevent this reasonable enfeoffment from being challenged by the malice of anyone or lost to the knowledge of posterity through oblivion, we have had this charter written and confirmed with the seals of ourselves and our chapter. Publicly enacted at St. Gall in the year of the Lord’s Incarnation 1222, on the Kalends of May; in the tenth indiction, the seventh year of the nineteen-year cycle, epact six, concurrent five, Sunday letter B; in the third year of our election; Pope Honorius III presiding in the sixth year of his pontificate, and the most glorious Roman Emperor Frederick reigning in the third year of his rule. Witnesses: Manegold, dean; Konrad, provost; Liutold, dean; Burchard, sacristan; Gozold, Hermann, Konrad, Rudolf, Rudeger, Master Konrad, Heinrich, Gottfried, Burchard, Ernesto, Egelolf of Capella; Walther, priest of Kirchberg; Ulrich, priest of Gozau; Heinrich, priest at Wädenswil; Ulrich, steward; Heinrich, marshal of Falkenstein; Wernher and Diethalm, brothers of Thundorf; Ulrich of Niederdorf; Konrad of Curia; Heinrich of Bichwil; Konrad, chamberlain; Liutold of Schwarzenbach; Wilhelm of Steinach; Heinrich of Steig; Bertold, cook; Rudolf, steward; Master Gerung, and many others. In the Lord, amen.

Two seals on colored cords, badly damaged; first, fig. 7; second, fig. 2.
